# ChunkDestroying

Kind: tag · Defined in [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

Out of view distance: destroyed once the GPU and the workers are done with it

## Notes

Added by ChunkManager (the chunk leaves ChunkMap at once), consumed by TerrainSys.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: CameraWalk, Capture, ChunkGenerator, Forest, ProbeVolume, RayScene, Terrain, VegetationScatter. Written by: ChunkManager. Created by: ChunkManager. Destroyed by: Terrain.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (terrainReady, unplanted view) | excluded: chunks on their way out are not waited for |
| [ChunkGenerator](../systems/ChunkGenerator.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | chunks being unloaded are not generated |
| [ChunkManager](../systems/ChunkManager.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | tick | put on chunks farther than view distance + 256 |
| [Forest](../systems/Forest.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | excluded: a chunk on its way out is not planted |
| [Terrain](../systems/Terrain.md) | system | Host | **read+destroy** | tick | chunks out of view distance (without ChunkGenerating): their slot is freed later and the entity destroyed |
| [VegetationScatter](../systems/VegetationScatter.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | excluded from the view |
| [Capture](../systems/service-Capture.md) | service | Host | **read** | due (terrainReady) | excluded from the wait |
| [ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md) | service | Host | **read** | syncBricks | Going chunks lose their brick. |
| [RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md) | service | Host | **read** | updateChunks | Excluded from builds and from pending. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md)**
  - Log lines "CameraWalk : from x z heading ..." (plan), soil / herds scores, and each herd it turns to.
  - profile::message("CameraWalk : started") when the route is made and ("CameraWalk : finished") at the end: tools/profile_run.py --between cuts on them; DY_FRAME_NAMED("Walk") marks every frame of the walk; CPU zone "Route the walk".
  - Reads species geometry files through VegetationLibrary::loadSpecies / loadGeometry (once per species, main thread).
  - With "exit", ends the process at the end of the walk (Input::EXIT).
- **[Capture](../systems/service-Capture.md)**
  - Reads the capture script (constructor; Game::start also reads its scene and vars with readScene).
  - Pushes SDL key, mouse button and motion events (sendInput) that InputSys reads the same frame; sets ImGui's MousePos; with hide_ui sets ImGui's style alpha to 0.
  - Creates capture_dir and writes <capture_dir>/<shot>.png (stb_image_write) from the renderer's readback; logs each shot and late shots.
  - Fails the run (Game::start returns 1) when a shot waits more than 1200 frames for the terrain or a PNG cannot be written; a late sequence frame delays the ones after it.
- **[ChunkGenerator](../systems/ChunkGenerator.md)**
  - Up to 16 taskflow silent_async jobs at a time (all pending chunks in deterministic runs), FastNoise2 on worker threads.
  - Blocks the main thread on the jobs in deterministic runs and in finish.
  - Profiler zones Generate chunk, Wait for the chunks; plot Chunk jobs.
- **[ChunkManager](../systems/ChunkManager.md)**
  - Creates one entity per chunk coming into range; never destroys (TerrainSys destroys ChunkDestroying chunks).
- **[Forest](../systems/Forest.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkForest> in preinit (onChunkForestDestroyed), disconnects in finish.
  - Reads ./resources/forest/tautavel.forest.json (or `definition`) in init, and resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates the plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs info (stands, layers, species, patch size), a warning per species the library lacks, an error without a terrain generator or with a bad definition (the system then does nothing).
- **[ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md)**
  - Allocates pages of 3D probe textures (61 MB each, logged), uploads the brick table and the probe classes.
  - Records the probe dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes the Context probe pointers read by every view set; waits for the device when its buffer grows.
- **[RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md)**
  - Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
  - Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
  - Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.
- **[Terrain](../systems/Terrain.md)**
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin (throws when it is not 256 x 16 bytes) and ./resources/shaders/marchingcubes.comp.glsl.spv in init.
  - Allocates GPU memory: indirect buffer (2048 slots), staging ring (ring size x 8 chunks), lookup texel buffer, a 3 MB vertex buffer per slot (2^15 triangles x 3 vertices x 32 bytes, ray tracing usages when enabled), a readback buffer with ray tracing; descriptor pool and sets, compute pipeline.
  - Records into the compute command buffer of the frame: indirect resets, one dispatch per chunk, a clamp pass, with ray tracing copies of the indirect commands to the readback buffer; Tracy GPU zone "Marching cubes", CPU zone "Mesh chunks", plot "Chunks meshed".
  - Destroys the entities of chunks marked ChunkDestroying (all their components go with them).
  - Logs a warning "Terrain : out of chunk slots" when 2048 slots are used.
  - The destructor waits for the device to be idle and clears its components and TerrainBuffers.
- **[VegetationScatter](../systems/VegetationScatter.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkPlants> in preinit, disconnects in finish.
  - Reads resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs the selected species (info) and a warning per unknown id.
